name: Release build
responsibility: Lays out the npm packages of one release in dist/release and packs them: two launchers and a platform package for each target
description: bun run release, in a checkout whose frontend and core are built, or in the source tree of the flake, where nix build .#release runs it offline. Each platform package gets the executable that Executable compile made, a manifest that lists the Codex binary of its platform at the pinned version, the LICENSE with the version as the Licensed Work, and the third-party notices of every npm package, Rust crate and font that the executable and the bundle are built from. It refuses a Codex pin that the protocol is not built for, a package that would run code on install, and a package that packs above its size budget.

outgoing.label: the script it copies as each launcher's bin
